content.text: In regions where [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-methods-filipino-digital-creators-first-principles-definitive|COREMERCH guide to payment]] platforms like Stripe and PayPal are restricted, digital creators face significant challenges in [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/setting-up-nowpayments-webhooks-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/cloudflare-r2-digital-product-storage-delivery-explained-digital-22|Cloudflare R2]]-workers-step-step-21|setting]] up online stores. This guide addresses that very issue by leveraging Supabase as your order database within the COREMERCH architecture. Specifically designed for creators in countries like Nigeria, Ghana, and Venezuela, this setup allows you to build a fully functional digital store that accepts crypto payments without relying on traditional payment gateways. You will learn how to deploy your store using Stack 01 or Stack 02, ensuring that you retain full ownership and control over your products and transactions.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The COREMERCH infrastructure is built for resilience against the failures of conventional platforms. In markets where options are limited, this system provides a reliable alternative focused on sovereignty and ownership. By utilizing tools like GitHub Pages and NOWPayments, creators bypass the restrictions imposed by traditional payment processors. This architecture ensures that you are not merely renting space on a platform; instead, you own your entire digital store. The combination of free hosting, automatic crypto payment processing, and immediate product delivery creates an ecosystem where creators can thrive despite external economic pressures.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying your digital store, you must prepare a few essential components. First, determine the digital products you plan to sell, such as ebooks or courses. Next, set up your GitHub account for hosting your site. You will also need to establish a NOWPayments account for crypto processing. Familiarize yourself with Google Apps Script for backend logic and Supabase for order management. Preparing these elements in advance will streamline your deployment process, allowing you to launch your store efficiently and effectively. Additionally, ensure you have access to the Sovereign Blueprint documentation for detailed guidance.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

To establish a seamless payment and delivery pipeline, begin by integrating NOWPayments into your store setup. This involves connecting your crypto wallet and configuring the payment gateway to accept the currencies you wish to support. Next, utilize Google Apps Script to automate order processing and confirm payments. This script will handle incoming orders and update your database in Supabase accordingly. For product delivery, ensure that your files are accessible via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. This combination allows for instant digital product delivery once payment is confirmed, enhancing the customer experience while maintaining control over your sales process.
Own your digital store infrastructure — no dependencies.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your store is set up and your payment pipeline is configured, it’s time to go live. Publish your site on GitHub Pages and verify that all pages load correctly. Before promoting your store, conduct a test transaction to ensure that everything functions smoothly from order placement to payment confirmation. This test will confirm that your integration with NOWPayments is active and that your order database in Supabase updates as expected. Once you successfully process your first transaction, you can confidently promote your store and begin selling your digital products to an audience that values straightforward crypto payments.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

After your store is operational, consider strategies for scaling your business effectively. Start by analyzing customer feedback and transaction data stored in Supabase to identify popular products. You can expand your offerings by adding new digital items based on this data. Additionally, leverage social media marketing and content creation to drive traffic to your store. Monitor your crypto payments and adjust your pricing strategy as needed to remain competitive. With the COREMERCH infrastructure, you have a robust foundation that allows for growth without the limitations often imposed by traditional e-commerce platforms.
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

To build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free, leverage the COREMERCH infrastructure. Set up a combination of GitHub Pages for hosting, Google Apps Script for backend logic, and NOWPayments for handling cryptocurrency transactions. This approach ensures you own the entire system without reliance on conventional payment platforms.
Process crypto payments seamlessly with NOWPayments.

This guide connects to related searches about using GitHub Pages and Cloudflare Pages to host a digital product store while accepting crypto payments for free. For a more comprehensive solution, consider the Edge Commerce Stack ($197), which provides an end-to-end tested setup ready for deployment in 48 hours. For further details, visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Follow the setup sequence without skipping steps — configuration errors are significantly harder to diagnose than setup time. First: create your NOWPayments account, add wallet addresses, generate your API key, and note your IPN secret key. Second: deploy the backend — configure Cloudflare Worker with your NOWPayments credentials and product settings, or configure Google Apps Script with the same — and confirm the endpoint URL. Third: set the webhook endpoint URL in your NOWPayments IPN settings. Fourth: deploy the storefront to Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages and confirm product pages and checkout display correctly. Fifth: configure your custom domain and DNS if using one. Sixth: complete a real mainnet test transaction. Seventh: check the order database for the test entry. Only after steps six and seven pass cleanly should you share the store URL publicly.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

To build a free digital store that accepts crypto payments, utilize GitHub Pages for hosting and integrate NOWPayments for transaction processing. Implement Google Apps Script for backend logic and manage your orders with Supabase, ensuring you maintain full control over your store.
What is the difference between Stack 01 and Stack 02 in COREMERCH?

Stack 01 utilizes GitHub Pages and Apps Script for deployment, taking 4-6 hours to set up. In contrast, Stack 02 employs Cloudflare Pages, Workers, and Supabase, offering a more comprehensive solution deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours with end-to-end testing.
Can I host a digital product store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages?

Yes, you can host your digital product store on either GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Both platforms provide free hosting solutions, allowing you to create and manage your online store without incurring additional costs.
What types of digital products can I sell?

You can sell various digital products, including ebooks, online courses, templates, software, and music files. The COREMERCH infrastructure supports a flexible setup to accommodate any digital offering you choose to provide.
How secure is the payment processing with NOWPayments?

Payment processing with NOWPayments is highly secure, utilizing blockchain technology for transaction verification. It requires no KYC from buyers, ensuring privacy while allowing you to receive payments in over 300 cryptocurrencies at a low fee.
